data.name: Angle
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Angle was the goddess of the bend or curve. She was also associated with the turning of the seasons and the changing of the year. The name Angle comes from the Old English word ‘engel’, which means ‘messenger’ or ‘angel’. In Christianity, Angels are celestial beings who serve as messengers of God.
